tei:div.tei:p: dpal rgyal dbang karma pa gsum pa rang byung rdo rjes mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs rgyan gyi sa bcad snang byed sgron me gzhung dang bcas pa dang*/ sher phyin skabs brgyad kyi stong thun dang*/ dbu ma chos dbyings bstod pa'i rnam bshad bcas 'di rnams kyi ma dpe ni/ sngon chad bod gangs can ljongs su bris ma re zung mjal rgyu yod pa ma gtogs rgya bal 'brug la sogs par dpe rgyun shin tu dkon/ da lam 7skyabs rje rdo rje 'chang mkhan chen khra 'gu rin po che mchog nas gzhung de rnams kyi ma phyi thabs 'tshol gnang ste/ dpe rnying bris ma zhig rnyed son byung ba dang glog klad nang bcug ste/ ma dper yig nor phran bu song ba rnams nor bcos cung zad bgyis te/ de byings rang sor bzhag nas da lam wā ṇa badzra bidyā dpe mdzod khang nas gsar du par skrun zhus pa 'di la nyams myong dang shes rgya dman pa'i dbang gis chad lhag dang nor 'khrul sogs mchis na/ rgya cher gzigs pa po rnams kyi spyan sngar bzod gsol zhu ba dang chabs cig bka' slob lhug stsol yong bar zhu/ wā ṇa badzra bidyā dpe mdzod khang nas/ spyi lo 2004 zla 8 tshes 12 la/
